description: Large free-living wrist-worn accelerometer corpus. 151 participants, ~24 h each, Axivity AX3 on the dominant wrist at 100 Hz. Raw triaxial acceleration in g (INCLUDES gravity). Camera+diary annotations mapped to the WillettsSpecific2018 10-class activity scheme. Accelerometer only.
